blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—It’s no secret that Letran’s Chad Gammad has been under the bright spotlight of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament. But after the Knights’ 99-62 drubbing of San Sebastian at San Juan Arena on Friday, Gammad made it clear that the attention disappears once he steps on the court. “For me, there’s pressure in popularity but when I’m on the court, all that’s gone. I just play,” he said. “I don’t think about anything else. When I’m on the court, I just play basketball.” “All I listen to is my coaches’ advice. I listen to them so I can […]...
